quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #9
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 35

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: No right turn.
Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
Curve ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers which direction they must drive. You must follow the arrow on the sign.

questions.question: When a bicyclist is making a left turn, what can they do?

options.text: They may use the left lane.
They may cut through all lanes.
They may wait on the side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: They may use the left lane.
questions.explanation: Bicycles ride with traffic on the road, just like cars. It is normal to see a bicyclist use the left lane when turning left.

questions.question: What do broken yellow lines do on streets and highways?

options.text: Mark areas where passing is not allowed.
Separate lanes of traffic moving in the same direction.
Separate lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Separate lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. Broken yellow lines mean passing is allowed when it is safe.

questions.question: When driving on the highway, looking far ahead helps you:

options.text: Keep up with other traffic.
Avoid sudden braking or turning.
Spot police officers ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid sudden braking or turning.
questions.explanation: Looking ahead lets you see problems before they happen. This way, you can slow down or change lanes smoothly instead of making sudden moves. It also saves fuel and keeps traffic moving safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A divided highway is ending.
A divided highway is starting ahead.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A divided highway is starting ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a divided highway begins ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A stop sign is ahead.
A side road is ahead.
A railroad is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A stop sign is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: When should your wheels NOT be pointed straight ahead?

options.text: When waiting to turn left at a traffic light.
When parked on a hill or slope.
When parked on a level street with no curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: When parked on a hill or slope.
questions.explanation: When turning left at a light, keep wheels straight so a rear-end hit does not push you into oncoming traffic. On hills or slopes, turn wheels toward the curb or away from traffic. This prevents your car from rolling into traffic if the brakes fail.

questions.question: What does this speed limit sign mean?

options.text: You must drive through the intersection at this speed.
The highest speed you can drive is 55 mph in good conditions.
You must not drive slower than this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest speed you can drive is 55 mph in good conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum speed limit on that road. You can drive slower based on road conditions, but you cannot drive faster than the posted limit.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?

options.text: Information about services for drivers.
Information about construction and road work.
Distance information to specific locations.

questions.correctAnswerText: Information about services for drivers.
questions.explanation: Blue signs give information about driver services. These include rest areas, food, gas, and hospitals nearby.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing yellow light at an intersection?

options.text: Stop before entering the intersection.
Slow down and look both ways before going.
Wait for a green light before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and look both ways before going.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and check for other traffic. Look both ways and proceed carefully.

questions.question: When changing lanes, what should you do?

options.text: Use only the rearview mirror.
Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move.
Use only the left side mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move.
questions.explanation: Look over your shoulder to check your blind spot before changing lanes. You may need to look several times. Watch traffic in front of you and in the lane next to you.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Curves ahead.
Divided highway starts.
Divided highway ends.

questions.correctAnswerText: Divided highway ends.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the divided highway is ending. Get ready to change lanes or adjust your position.

questions.question: What does a flashing red traffic light mean?

options.text: The same as a yield sign.
The light is about to turn green.
The same as a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same as a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must stop completely. Yield to other traffic and pedestrians. Go only when it is safe. This is the same as a stop sign.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Yield the right-of-way.
No passing zone.
Reduction in lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.question: How should you make a right turn?

options.text: Signal, slow down, and move to the lane closest to the centerline before turning.
Signal, slow down, and move to the lane closest to the right curb before turning.
Approach from the right lane, then move toward the middle of the street before turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, slow down, and move to the lane closest to the right curb before turning.
questions.explanation: Signal to tell other drivers your plan. Slow down and use the right lane. Stay as close as practical to the right curb or edge before turning.

questions.question: What does this pennant-shaped sign mean?

options.text: No passing zone.
Right turn allowed on red.
Yield right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: No passing zone.
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks where a no passing zone starts.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line mean?

options.text: Passing is allowed from the lane next to the solid yellow line.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.
Passing is allowed from the lane next to the broken yellow line.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is allowed from the lane next to the broken yellow line.
questions.explanation: When a broken yellow line is next to a solid yellow line, drivers in the lane next to the broken line may pass. Drivers in the lane next to the solid line cannot pass.

questions.question: The intersection ahead is blocked by traffic, but you have a green light. What should you do?

options.text: Turn left and find another route.
Stay out of the intersection until traffic clears.
Follow other vehicles and enter the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay out of the intersection until traffic clears.
questions.explanation: Do not enter the intersection if traffic is blocking your way, even if the light is green. If you get stuck in the intersection when the light turns red, you will block other traffic and may get a ticket.

questions.question: At dawn, dusk, rain, or snow, how can you let other drivers know you are there?

options.text: Turn on the instrument panel lights.
Turn on your parking lights.
Turn on your headlights.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on your headlights.
questions.explanation: Use your headlights when you cannot see other vehicles clearly or when other drivers may not see you. Use low beam headlights when weather requires you to use windshield wipers.

questions.question: What is the term for the amount of alcohol in the blood?

options.text: Implied consent (IC).
Blood alcohol concentration (BAC).
Rate of alcohol consumption (RAC).

questions.correctAnswerText: Blood alcohol concentration (BAC).
questions.explanation: Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) measures the percentage of alcohol in your blood. A higher BAC number means more impairment.

questions.question: You see a steady yellow traffic light ahead and have not entered the intersection yet. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up to cross before the red light.
Slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.
Stop safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop safely.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means you should prepare to stop. If you are already in the intersection, drive through quickly and safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ends ahead.
The road splits. You must go right or left.
A four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road splits. You must go right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road splits into two paths. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: Driving too fast:

options.text: Does not make crashes more likely.
Helps you react faster to danger.
Often causes risky driving decisions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Often causes risky driving decisions.
questions.explanation: Speeding is a major cause of car crashes. It does not save time and often leads to dangerous driving choices.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Winding road ahead
Loose gravel ahead
Road is slippery when wet

questions.correctAnswerText: Road is slippery when wet
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet. Drive carefully on slippery roads.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn ahead.
A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road ahead will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: You are parking downhill on a two-way road with no curb. Which way should you turn your front wheels?

options.text: Straight ahead
Right, toward the edge of the road
Left, toward the center of the road

questions.correctAnswerText: Right, toward the edge of the road
questions.explanation: When parking downhill with or without a curb, turn your wheels toward the road edge. This way, if your brakes fail, your car will roll away from traffic. When parking uphill on a road with a curb, turn wheels toward the center so the car rolls into the curb.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking reserved for people with disabilities.
Slow-moving vehicle.
No U-turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking reserved for people with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates, disabled veteran plates, or disability parking permits.

questions.question: This is a:

options.text: Service sign.
Regulatory sign.
Warning sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warning sign.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions that are coming up. This may include a change in traffic direction, a steep hill, or another hazard that requires action.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Do not enter.
Roundabout ahead.
No U-turns allowed.

questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turns allowed.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers what traffic laws they must follow. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers that:

options.text: A construction flagger is ahead.
A police officer is ahead.
A parking attendant is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A construction flagger is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flag person is ahead. Always follow their directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests or bright jackets. They use paddles and red flags to direct traffic and help workers cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You cannot turn left here.
You can turn left only after you stop.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot turn left here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
Traffic moves in both directions on this road.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in both directions on this road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic moves in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Directions for children
A school zone is near or ahead
A playground is ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: A school zone is near or ahead
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn you that you are in or near a school zone. Watch for children and follow the posted speed limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A school zone or crossing is ahead.
A pedestrian crossing is ahead.
A railroad is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A school zone or crossing is ahead.
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign means a school zone or school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: People may be crossing the street.
A school crossing is ahead.
A jogging trail is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: People may be crossing the street.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers to watch for people crossing the street.

questions.question: You want to enter the freeway but you don't see a gap in traffic. What should you do?

options.text: Keep your speed and force other drivers to make room.
Slow down on the ramp and wait for a gap.
Stop at the end of the ramp and wait for a gap.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down on the ramp and wait for a gap.
questions.explanation: Slow down on the ramp to wait for a gap in traffic. Do not stop at the end of the ramp because you need room to speed up and match traffic before you merge onto the freeway.

questions.question: A blood alcohol concentration of 0.02 percent:

options.text: Will not affect your driving.
Will not put other drivers at risk.
Doubles your risk of a fatal crash.

questions.correctAnswerText: Doubles your risk of a fatal crash.
questions.explanation: Each 0.02 percent increase in blood alcohol concentration nearly doubles your risk of having a fatal crash.

questions.question: A broken yellow line in the center of the road means:

options.text: You cannot pass.
You can pass on the right when it is safe.
You can pass on the left when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass on the left when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line on your side means you can cross it to pass another vehicle on the left when the road ahead is clear.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: A sharp right turn is ahead.
This lane must turn right.
You can only turn right on a green arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: A sharp right turn is ahead.
questions.explanation: Yellow or yellow-green warning signs alert you to upcoming road conditions like curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: Your car's rear end is skidding to the left. What should you do?

options.text: Steer to the right.
Steer to the left.
Lightly tap the brakes and shift into neutral.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steer to the left.
questions.explanation: If your car skids, remove your foot from the brake and steer in the direction you want the front of the car to go. If the rear skids left, steer left to straighten the car.
